_comment: The vocabulary of the fault surface (issue #24). One definition of the six faults a job can be made to suffer on demand; the control plane (orchestrator and fake provider) and the trainer image both read this file, so the two sides cannot drift about what a fault is called, which code it carries, and which side is responsible for making it real. A value two components must agree on is defined once and read, never retyped.

faults.name: divergence
faults.description: drive the loss to a meaningless value

faults.name: machine_silent
faults.description: make the machine go silent without ending

faults.name: orphan
faults.description: leave a machine running with no job that owns it

faults.name: destroy_refused
faults.description: make the provider refuse a destroy
